finalText:
**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** All 36 call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `node --check` passes on every file.

Left alone on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` at [adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) and [:13](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:13). Its header says the copy is replaced wholesale on upgrade and local edits are lost.

Also untouched: `cache.query`. Different object, not part of this move.

Next: decide the vendor path. Options are pin a patched fork or wrap the adapter.
